title: Wasm Fmpz Buffer Gate
objective: Fail closed before wasm32 C compilation when production kernels require unsupported resident fmpz IntegerBuffer views, while preserving qualified native targets and exact fallback semantics

oracles: Generated wasm32 production pack omits unsupported resident-fmpz-buffer kernels and retained supported kernels compile and execute differentially

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern=resident fmpz IntegerBuffers|production linking uses only|generated runtime manifests expose|production resource closure records test/wasm-production-native-kernels.cjs test/wasm-production-resource-closure.cjs

handoff.summary: Wasm production inventory now fails closed before C compilation when a generated core combines resident fmpz arithmetic with 64-bit-word IntegerBuffer views on 32-bit FLINT limbs. The unsupported cubic class-group route retains authenticated source/core identity and same-source fallback metadata, while only callable module identities enter pack identity and linking. A real wasm32 regression links the neighboring rank-four FLINT core and proves the cubic route unavailable.
risks: The distribution builder must select kernels through productionKernelsForPack(manifest.kernels, pack), rather than selecting every kernel sharing pack.domain, before PR #101 chromium parity is fixed.
Canonical Wasm coverage and capability manifests need deterministic regeneration after integration; they currently predate the one-function fallback classification.
next_steps: In packages/flint-wasm/scripts/build.cjs import productionKernelsForPack from tools/native-kernel/wasm-production-pack.cjs and replace the domain-only kernel filter with productionKernelsForPack(manifest.kernels, pack).
Run node scripts/generate-wasm-kernel-coverage.cjs followed by pnpm wasm:workload-dashboard, review the generated capability/coverage diff, and commit it in the integration lane.

Run pnpm --dir packages/flint-wasm build with the pinned toolchain and the focused Wasm production tests; confirm 280 compiled functions, one explicit same-source fallback, and no cubic core in clang inputs.
